description: Source code for an SDR radio RX power analyzer application, performing measurements over a range of RX gain values, with optional transmission of random IQ samples, and outputting results to console or CSV.

classes.name: radio_notifier_spy
classes.description: A class for handling radio notifications and logging.

methods.name: interrupt_signal_handler
methods.description: Handles interrupt signals to stop radio and set stop flag.

methods.name: cleanup_signal_handler
methods.description: Handles cleanup signals to flush logs.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to configure the program.

methods.name: write_results_csv
methods.description: Writes measurement results to a CSV file.

methods.name: resize_buffers
methods.description: Resizes and initializes TX and RX buffers, filling TX buffer with random data.
